playstyle.identity: Ambessa is a dashing bruiser who chains ability combos for constant repositioning. She excels at extended fights where she can weave dashes between abilities.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive lets you dash after abilities. Q slashes and resets. W blocks and counters. E is a combo tool dash. R marks and lets you repeatedly dash to targets. Chain abilities with passive dashes for constant mobility.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Ambessa spikes at level 3 with full combo access and level 6 with her chase ultimate. Trinity Force and bruiser items scale her. She's strong in skirmishes throughout.

passive.name: Drakehound's Step
passive.summary: After abilities, next auto dashes you forward and deals bonus damage.
passive.details: Casting abilities empowers Ambessa's next basic attack to dash her toward the target, dealing bonus damage and healing her.

abilities.name: Cunning Sweep
abilities.summary: Slash in a direction; hitting enemies resets it once.
abilities.details: Ambessa slashes in a direction, dealing damage. If it hits an enemy, she can recast once. Generates energy for her passive.

abilities.name: Repudiation
abilities.summary: Enter a defensive stance; block damage then counter-strike.
abilities.details: Ambessa braces, reducing incoming damage from one direction. After blocking or after the duration, she strikes forward dealing damage.

abilities.name: Lacerate
abilities.summary: Dash and slash, pulling enemies hit toward you.
abilities.details: Ambessa dashes and slashes, dealing damage and pulling enemies slightly toward her. Good combo starter or extender.

abilities.name: Public Execution
abilities.summary: Mark an enemy; gain repeated dashes toward marked targets.
abilities.details: Ambessa marks an enemy champion. While marked, she can repeatedly dash to them, dealing damage. Marking a new target refreshes the ability.
